title: How is residual salt removed from springs after austempering?
summary: Suneng's mesh-belt austempering proposal for spring parts, dated 18 May 2026, places an adjustable extraction device at the heating-furnace discharge to prevent salt vapour entering the chamber. After the parts leave the salt tank, separate residual-salt blow-off and water washing are proposed. These provisions act at different locations and on different materials: extraction cannot replace removal of salt from parts, and a washing tank cannot replace extraction after the furnace. Procurement should trace the routes of both parts and gases to establish connections and supply responsibilities.
